name: Decoy!
summary: At the Winterspring handover, Narain Soothfancy means to deliver the ransom after a fashion. You carry Narain's disguise to the spot the booknappers named, following the ransom letter.

sections.title: Narain's Scheme
sections.body: The ransom note said Narain should make the delivery himself. He plans to do so after a fashion, and chooses you for the part. His special kit holds a turban, a robe, and a sack filled with rocks. You carry the disguise to the handover spot the booknappers named in Winterspring. When they arrive for the goods, Narain wants them snuffed out as a lesson in what comes of crossing him.

sections.title: Narain's Verdict
sections.body: When you return, Narain admits that he and you may have underestimated the booknappers.

faq.q: Why does Narain want you to wear a disguise?
faq.answer: The ransom note said Narain should make the delivery himself. He means to do so after a fashion by sending you in his place, with the turban and robe from his special kit.

faq.q: Where does the handover take place?
aliases: where do i take the bag
faq.answer: The handover takes place at the spot in Winterspring that the booknappers named. That is where the sack of rocks is to be left.

faq.q: What is inside the ransom bag?
faq.answer: Narain fills the sack with rocks instead of money.
Before this, the ransom letter demanded money for Narain's stolen book, which you carried back to him.
